# Textarea

Multi-line input with the same variants, borders and focus ring as Input.

`KenosUI.Textarea` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Textarea />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Textarea"></x-import>
```

## Props (TextareaProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"outline" \| "subtle" \| "flushed"` |  |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  |
| `mono` | `boolean` | Monospace, no spell-check: YAML, cloud-init, scripts. |

_Also accepts: React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>._
